first_step_test: A single upright front carton outline gives the learner a useful centered object and leaves clear corners for the side and roof.

source.notes: Third six-panel marker sheet approved after rejecting two sheets with roof redraw and row scale drift; both failures preserved privately.

final_elements.name: front carton silhouette
final_elements.description: One centered carton front with a low trapezoid folded roof already joined to its vertical sides and rounded base.

final_elements.name: right side panel
final_elements.description: A narrow panel attached to the right front edge.

final_elements.name: top seams and straw port
final_elements.description: One slanted left fold seam and one small oval straw port on the established roof.

final_elements.name: bendy straw
final_elements.description: One thick black straw that rises and bends to the right.

final_elements.name: front fruit emblem
final_elements.description: An orange slice circle with exactly six radial wedge sections and one small leaf.

frames.visible_job: Draw the tall front panel and low folded roof together.
frames.instruction: Draw a tall rounded carton front, then lift its top corners into a low trapezoid roof with a short flat crest.

frames.visible_job: One narrow right side panel attaches.
frames.instruction: From the upper-right and lower-right corners, draw short diagonals and join them with a vertical side edge.

frames.visible_job: Add a left fold seam and a small oval straw port on the established roof.
frames.instruction: On the roof, draw a short slanted seam near the left corner and one small oval straw port near the center.
From the oval port, draw one thick straw upward, bend it right, and finish its short open tip. Add short stripe marks along the bend and a short right roof seam.

frames.visible_job: Add a six-wedge fruit circle and attached pointed leaf.
frames.instruction: On the carton front, draw one orange-slice circle with six radial wedge lines from its center; attach one small pointed leaf above its right rim.

final_step.visible_job: Add orange and teal marker fills inside established contours.
final_step.instruction: Fill the front and top warm orange, the side panel teal, the straw coral, and the six-wedge slice yellow. Color the leaf green while keeping every black contour visible.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop shows one centered front panel with low trapezoid roof, vertical sides and rounded bottom at their final anchors. The simple silhouette is copyable before details.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Viewed the approved six-cell sheet and saved finish. Front, low roof, right face, top seam, oval port, bent striped straw and six-wedge fruit mark retain their anchors. Port becomes a visible collar around the straw. No temporary guides, silent erasures or moved landmarks.

transitions.observed_addition: The front panel and low roof remain; a narrow right face joins their upper and lower right corners.
transitions.instruction_match: The side instruction attaches short diagonals and a vertical edge to those existing corners.

transitions.observed_addition: The front and right side remain; a left roof fold seam and small oval port appear on the top.
transitions.instruction_match: The top-fold instruction names the existing roof as the location for both marks.

transitions.observed_addition: The box and port remain fixed; a thick striped straw rises from the port, bends right, and a short right roof seam appears.
transitions.instruction_match: The straw instruction matches the visible collar, bend stripes, tip, and roof seam.

transitions.observed_addition: Carton, roof and straw remain; a centered fruit circle gains six radial wedges and one pointed leaf.
transitions.instruction_match: The emblem instruction gives the exact six wedges and leaf attachment on the front.

transitions.observed_addition: All five landmarks retain their contours; orange, teal, coral, yellow and green marker fills appear within them.
transitions.instruction_match: The finishing instruction places color only inside the existing carton, straw and fruit regions.
